entities.summary: Janusz Ignacy Symonides was a Polish jurist, diplomat and university professor. A graduate of Central School of Foreign Service, he was a law professor at the University of Warsaw. His publications include focuses on human rights, the law of the sea, public international law and modern political areas of thought.
